title: Registry history reader (git log per registry path)
description: Per METARULE 1 the registry's history is part of the registry. Add one internal helper that lists, for a registry path, every version with commit id, committer date, parent, and content (or deletion), via git log/show with argument lists. Used by D1 warnings (ey47.11), D5 removal dates (ey47.6), and history-based check rules. Must work on a real clone; refuse a shallow clone with a clear error.
acceptance_criteria: Tests on a real temp git repo: versions listed in commit order with correct dates; deletions reported; shallow clone refused. Oracle: git history built by the test itself with fixed GIT_COMMITTER_DATE values.
notes: Implemented file_history(root, rel) -> list[Version(commit, date UTC committer, parents tuple (empty=root, >1=merge), data bytes|None=deleted)] in git-vouch; tests/test_history.py. One git log call: --no-replace-objects --full-history -c --raw --root --no-renames --no-abbrev -z --topo-order --reverse. Every side-branch commit is listed (no simplification); a merge is listed only when rel differs from every parent (conflict resolution). Entry order is topological: callers must compare a version against rel at each of its parents, never against the adjacent entry. Symlinks, gitlinks and directories at rel are refused as not a regular file. Open questions for owner: (1) for D5 removal dates, should a deletion on a merged branch use the side commit's committer date (current) or the merge's? (2) a merge version that resolves a conflict: must it be signed by a key from the first parent's version, any parent's, or every parent's?
